描述_EN: the roundels are placed so that, when the material is cut and sewn to make a robe or jacket, the design is evenly spaced and sits well on the back and front of the finished garment. this gold-brown length of silk has subdued twill roundels woven along its length. this type of roundel pattern lends itself to east asian straight-seamed tailoring - not the only dressmaking tradition in that region, but one of the most popular.
描述_ZN: 圆点的位置是这样的，当材料被切割和缝制成长袍或夹克时，设计是均匀间隔的，并且很好地坐落在成品服装的背面和正面。 这段金棕色的丝绸，沿其长度方向织有低调的斜纹圆点。 这种圆形图案适合于东亚的直缝裁缝--这不是该地区唯一的制衣传统，但却是最受欢迎的传统之一。
